div.span: cle_recovery.js records executed line index N in LocalStorage
Lookup last recorded line index N from LocalStorage
Compute Recovery Line: R = max(0, N - 5)
Emit G0 X{R} Y{R} (Rapid to recovery starting point)
Emit M3 S{RPM} & G4 P3.0 (Dwell 3 sec for spindle up-to-speed)
Stream remaining G-Code lines from index R to end
Continuous carving seamlessly resumed without gouging!
